title: Same-hardware end-to-end cost of the clean-trained final pipeline
notes: Measures the full online path: raw preprocessing, DYN extraction, MOMENT original and diff encoding, TCN forward, and the HGB/logistic/meta heads.
Single seed 42 / 40% checkpoint; cost is a pipeline measurement, not a multi-seed accuracy result.
No test split is read; no cached head timing is used as end-to-end latency.
